en_title: The Last of Us Part 2 Leaks Made Backlash Worse, Laura Bailey Says
cn_title: Laura Bailey称《最后生还者 第二部》泄露事件加剧了外界的强烈反对
opus_summary: 《最后生还者 第二部》演员Laura Bailey表示，游戏发售前的泄密及随后错误信息的传播加剧了网络负面反响。她称，涉及Abby的关键场景在缺少叙事背景的情况下泄露，自己和家人还不断收到死亡威胁。

paragraphs.en: The Last of Us Part 2 actress Laura Bailey has reflected on how the game's pre-release leaks and the subsequent spread of misinformation made its ensuing online backlash much worse.
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者 第二部》演员Laura Bailey回顾了游戏发售前的泄露事件及随后错误信息的传播，如何使接踵而来的网络反对声浪变得更加激烈。

paragraphs.en: More than six years after The Last of Us Part 2 leaks ignited controversy online and sparked a wave of death threats towards Bailey and her family, the prolific video game voice actress has now labelled Naughty Dog's highly-anticipated sequel as being "cursed" from the off.
paragraphs.cn: 《最后生还者 第二部》的泄露事件在网上引发争议，并导致Bailey及其家人收到一波死亡威胁，六年多后，这位作品丰富的电子游戏配音演员如今称顽皮狗这部备受期待的续作从一开始就受到了「诅咒」。

paragraphs.en: While acknowledging that the game's bold narrative choices would always have been polarizing, Bailey blamed the level of vitriol directed specifically at her on the leaks of specific scenes involving her character Abby that spoiled major plot points — and did so without the game's intended narrative context. Because of this, she believes, online outrage had already hardened across social media long before launch day.
paragraphs.cn: Bailey承认，游戏大胆的叙事选择无论如何都会引发两极分化的反应，但她将专门针对自己的激烈恶意归咎于涉及她所饰角色Abby的特定场景遭到泄露：这些场景剧透了重要情节，而且缺少游戏原本设定的叙事背景。她认为，正因如此，早在发售日到来之前，社交媒体上的愤怒情绪就已经固化。

paragraphs.en: Warning! If you're still worried about The Last of Us Part 2 spoilers, now's a good time to head elsewhere.
paragraphs.cn: 警告！如果你仍然担心被剧透《最后生还者 第二部》，现在正是离开的时候。

paragraphs.en: "That game got cursed by so many different elements," Bailey said, appearing on the Mythical Kitchen podcast. "It got leaked, nobody knew the full story and all that got leaked were these horrific scenes. It had been leaked that there's a trans character in the game. The scene comes out where [Abby] has got a golf club. It just turned into a nightmare online.
paragraphs.cn: Bailey在做客Mythical Kitchen播客时说：「那款游戏被许多不同的因素诅咒了。它遭到了泄露，没人知道完整的故事，而泄露出来的全是那些骇人的场景。游戏中有一个跨性别角色的消息也被泄露了。[Abby]拿着高尔夫球杆的场景流传了出来。网上的情况就这样变成了一场噩梦。

paragraphs.en: "They were looking into all of the active death threats that were coming in," Bailey continued. "Because it was constant. They threatening my parents, they were threatening my baby."
paragraphs.cn: Bailey继续说道：「他们当时正在调查所有不断收到的、仍然存在的死亡威胁。因为这些威胁从未间断。他们威胁我的父母，威胁我的宝宝。」

paragraphs.en: The leak of various cutscenes in April 2020 — several months before The Last of Us Part 2's official release — led franchise steward Neil Druckmann to say he had been left "heartbroken" at their impact after working for years on the game. Naughty Dog issued an official statement pleading with fans not to spread the spoilers further online but, predictably, such was the fan investment in The Last of Us Part 1's duo of Ellie and Joel that word of the latter's abrupt murder by Abby spread quickly across the internet.
paragraphs.cn: 2020年4月，也就是《最后生还者 第二部》正式发售的几个月前，多段过场动画遭到泄露。系列负责人Neil Druckmann表示，在为这款游戏工作多年后，他对泄露造成的影响感到「心碎」。顽皮狗发表官方声明，恳请粉丝不要在网上进一步传播剧透，但可以预见的是，粉丝们对《最后生还者 第一部》中的Ellie和Joel这对搭档投入了如此深厚的感情，以至于后者突然被Abby杀害的消息迅速传遍了互联网。

paragraphs.en: "I knew it was going to get a reaction because Joel is beloved and he is an amazing character," Bailey noted. "I loved him. I knew that was coming. But because of the leaks, it was just a lot. Up until then I was very present online and I shared a lot of my sense online. I kind of backed off after that.
paragraphs.cn: Bailey说道：「我知道这会引发反响，因为Joel深受喜爱，他是一个很棒的角色。我喜欢他。我知道反响会到来。但由于泄露事件，这一切实在太过了。在那之前，我在网上非常活跃，也在网上分享了很多自己的想法。那之后我就有些退缩了。

paragraphs.en: "The haters are very loud online," she concluded, "but there's a ton of people that love that game and still come up at cons to me, and are dressed as Abbie and say she changed their life and it's an amazing game. And it is, it's beautiful and the message of it is beautiful."
paragraphs.cn: 她最后说道：「那些讨厌它的人在网上的声音很大，但有很多人喜欢那款游戏，他们仍然会在展会上穿着Abbie的装扮来找我，说她改变了他们的生活，还说这是一款很棒的游戏。它确实如此，它很美，它所传达的信息也很美。」

paragraphs.en: Despite all of that, Bailey went on to win Best Performance at The Game Awards 2020, while IGN's The Last of Us: Part 2 returned a perfect 10/10 score.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管经历了这一切，Bailey后来还是在2020年The Game Awards上赢得了最佳表演奖，而IGN给《最后生还者 第二部》打出了10分满分。
